summary: Brandywine Realty Trust and its operating partnership filed an 8-K disclosing an Agreement of Sale to sell a 441,000 sq ft office property at 3151 Market Street, Philadelphia, to an unrelated buyer for $240 million ($544/sq ft), subject to adjustments. The property is 4% leased and encumbered by a $57.3 million mortgage repaid at closing; net proceeds are estimated at $168 million. Buyer deposited a $5 million non-refundable earnest money deposit. Closing is scheduled for September 30, 2026, subject to customary conditions. No board recommendation or advisors named. Watch for closing completion and use of proceeds; minimal risk-arb since sale is a one-off asset disposition.
